episode.title: Ask me EVERYTHING!
episode.tagline: We’ve reached episode 100 — HURRAY! — and it’s time for another session of Ask Me Anything. Amit and Ajay take questions from gentle readers about a variety of subjects, from Ajay’s love of suffering to Amit’s (dubious) haircare.  (The two are not related.) Mad fun, watch!
